I've implemented `Invoice.subtotal()` to return the sum of all line item amounts in paise:

```python
def subtotal(self):
    return sum(item.amount() for item in self.items)
```

This method iterates through all items in the invoice and sums their individual amounts (calculated as `qty * unit_paise`). All 10 tests in the test suite pass, including the `test_subtotal` test.
